scenario: [LTIM.2.6.2]: a `monotonic_ns()` read in a `where` on a rule with two positive patterns is DS_VALIDATE_NOW_MULTIPATTERN_UNSUPPORTED. `monotonic_ns()` is a clock read ([LTIM.2.4.1]), so the condition is time-dependent, and v1 re-evaluates one only on a single-positive-pattern rule. PATH: `dsc.validate.ltim_2_6_2_clock_where`, its `time_read` clock arm. [LEXP.9.6.1] keeps `cached()` alone.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Arm scope logical:
    k: Int key

schema Event scope logical:
    k: Int key

rule late:
    Arm a
    Event e where e.k == a.k and monotonic_ns() > 1_s
->
    log info "late"
